call_points.text: 20% loan growth guidance reiterated; FY27 disbursements seen at ₹6,500-6,800 Cr.

No rating upgrade expected until the second half of the year at the earliest, until cost-of-funds benefit shows.

Management expects to achieve AUM growth of around 20% for FY27 and thereafter.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the 42nd Annual General Meeting
Credit cost as % of average AUM

watchlist.response: Management said the earlier figure was on total assets (about 1.3-1.35% on AUM) and it now prefers a higher, more consistent credit cost to balance growth.
watchlist.text: Steady-state credit cost of 1.5-1.6% is well above the earlier 0.8-1% on total assets; analysts asked what changed.

watchlist.response: Management said the base is larger (₹13,000 Cr AUM vs ₹5,000-7,000 Cr when growing 30%+) and growth should rise from the 10-11% of FY26.
watchlist.text: Structural growth was earlier talked of as 25%; analysts asked why guidance is now 18-20%.

watchlist.response: Management said the ECL framework for banks starts only from 1 April 2027 and it does not expect the 5% floor for NBFCs soon, but is being conservative on credit cost.
watchlist.text: Stage-2 coverage is below the 5% floor RBI prescribed for banks; analysts asked about raising coverage.

watchlist.response: Management declined to detail the process on the call and asked the investor to connect offline.
watchlist.text: A new investor asked about sourcing, underwriting and turnaround time.

watchlist.response: Opex stays at 5.75-6% this year due to competitive employee compensation; leverage only from FY28, steady state 5.25-5.5%.
watchlist.text: Opex has risen to about 6% of assets from 5% historically; when will operating leverage kick in?

watchlist.response: Stronger collections lifted repayments; a policy change now gives top-ups to best customers instead of forcing full prepayment, which should help.
watchlist.text: Repayment rates have risen even as the share of longer-tenure loans grows.

watchlist.response: Partly true behaviourally, but gold price corrections in the last 6 months have slowed gold-loan growth; microfinance overlap fell from 20-21% to 16-17%.
watchlist.text: Is gold-loan growth masking underlying asset-quality weakness?

watchlist.response: Not before 6-8 quarters, given annual net worth additions of ₹1,100-1,200 Cr.
Evasive: asked the analyst to connect with the IR team separately.
watchlist.text: Data questions on collection efficiency and the 60-90 day bucket.
